examples.english: I look at the people in the street
examples.transliteration: anthur ila al nas fi al shari

examples.arabic: فهم الناس في السوق هذا الاختلاف بين الاجيال دائما
examples.english: The people in the market always understood this difference between generations.
examples.transliteration: Fahima an-nas fi as-suqi hadha al-ikhtilaf bayna al-ajyal da'iman.

examples.arabic: السوق كان كبيرا جدا ومليئا بالناس
examples.english: The market was very big and full of people.
examples.transliteration: Al-souq kana kabeeran jiddan wa malee'an bi-al-nas.
examples.storyTitle: A Humorous Trip to the Market

examples.arabic: ارى الناس يتحدثون كثيرا اين صديقي الان
examples.english: I see people talking a lot. Where is my friend now?
examples.transliteration: Ara an-nasa yatahaddathoon katheeran. Ayna sadeeqi al-aan?

examples.arabic: كان المقهى يعج بالناس من مختلف الاجيال يتجاذبون اطراف الحديث
examples.english: The cafe was bustling with people from different generations engaging in conversation.
examples.transliteration: Kana al-maqha ya'ujju bin-nas min mukhtalif al-ajyal yatajadhabuna atraf al-hadeeth.

examples.arabic: قلنا السلام عليكم للناس كنا سعداء
examples.english: We said "Hello" to people. We were happy.
examples.transliteration: Qulna as-salamu alaykum lil-nas kunna su'ada'
